data.name: lbl_controls.Text
data.value:
Challenge Mode consists of fixed levels designed to assess performance under time constraints. Each level is identical for all players, allowing results to be compared fairly. At the start of a level, the player takes one of two roles: Runner or Blocker. If the player is the Runner, the Blocker is controlled by a rule-based heuristic AI. If the player is the Blocker, the Runner is controlled by a reinforcement learning AI agent trained to reach the exit efficiently.
Runner (Player or AI) The Runner’s objective is to reach the exit before the timer reaches zero. Movement (player-controlled only): Use WASD or Arrow keys to move one tile at a time. Lives: The Runner starts with 3 lives. Failure conditions: The game ends if the Runner’s lives reach zero or if the level timer expires. Scoring: Final performance is influenced by completion time and tokens collected. Dash Ability Press Enter to dash up to 5 tiles in the last movement direction. A dash will occur even if the previous movement attempt was blocked. Dashing costs 5 coins. Any monster hit during the dash path or on landing is destroyed. When controlled by AI, the Runner selects actions using a trained policy rather than direct input.
Blocker (Player or AI) The Blocker’s objective is to delay the Runner and increase the likelihood of failure. When controlled by the player, abilities are activated using on-screen buttons and the mouse. When controlled by AI, decisions are made using heuristic rules based on the Runner’s position and movement. Abilities Wind Push: Select Wind, then press WASD or Arrow keys to push the Runner in that direction. Movement stops if the Runner collides with a wall or monster. Monster: Spawns a monster at a random valid location. Multiple monsters may exist simultaneously. Monsters automatically chase the Runner for 30 seconds. If a monster catches the Runner, one life is lost, the maze is reset, and all Blocker abilities are fully refreshed. Wall: Places a wall on a selected path tile. Walls cannot be placed adjacent to the start or exit tiles.
Ability Scaling and Refresh The maximum number of available Blocker abilities increases with level difficulty. Level 1 provides 1 Wind Push, 1 Monster, and 1 Wall. Each subsequent level increases the maximum count of each ability by 1. Each time the Runner loses a life, all Blocker abilities are refreshed back to their maximum values for that level.
Tokens and Coins Tokens and coins introduce a trade-off between speed and reward. Collecting tokens increases final performance score. Coins can be spent to activate dash abilities (5 coins per dash).
Progress Saving Progress and results are saved per level and per role when the user is logged in.
Maze Generation Mazes are generated randomly using a Depth-First Search (DFS) recursive backtracking algorithm, producing a perfect maze with exactly one valid path between any two points. This guarantees solvability while maintaining unpredictability.
